ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:20 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels; white pixels are strictly localized to distal tip clusters and linear surface streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigmentation covers >90% of the fluke surface. High-contrast white contiguous blobs are concentrated at the left and right distal tips. Sparse, high-contrast white linear filaments are scattered across the central and lower regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 42 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge; low-frequency peaks near the notch transitioning to high-frequency, higher-amplitude (10-15 pixel) jagged variations at the distal tips due to encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory from the peduncle transition, tapering into sharp, upwardly-curved distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) mapped to the extreme distal edges of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically and diagonally, predominantly visible on the inner-to-mid sections of the dark lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal tips; minor irregular notches along the trailing edge of the right lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white 'fringe' effect at the fluke tips created by dense, protruding barnacle clusters against the dark ventral background.
